CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   C. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately
